rca_of_issue: RCA for the FlatList numColumns error: (tabs)/community.tsx used a JSX ternary `{tab === 'boards' ? <FlatList numColumns={2} ... /> : <FlatList ... /> }`. When `tab` state flips, React's reconciler sees the same element type (`FlatList`) at the same position and reuses the same component instance, changing its numColumns prop from 2 to undefined. React Native FlatList explicitly forbids this and throws Invariant Violation. Adding distinct `key` props ('list-boards' and 'list-clubs') forces React to unmount the old FlatList and mount a new one, avoiding the runtime error. Verified by re-tapping the Clubs segment post-fix: no console errors, list renders, existing Club Candide clickable, detail screen navigates correctly.
